pos.personaBrief: Flamengo under Filipe Luis controlled games with possession (70%+ in the Libertadores final, Data'Scout possession 93) and he states 'propor sempre, posse no campo ofensivo'; possession is a defensive tool through ball-control and high press.

pro.personaBrief: Short build-up with a 3-2 exit and resistance to pressing (97), but he calls his model 'mais vertical' and the data shows low long-ball use; he wants runs from deep and quick attacks after pressing.

est.personaBrief: Jogo de Posicao with a 3-2 structure and defined phases, but with fluid zone occupation, rotations and a narrow shape with close combinations; he dislikes the striker dropping to look for the ball.

lar.personaBrief: TFA: extremely narrow structure with width from the ball-near player; mobile forwards and wingers who come to the ball. Soccerway also notes efficiency down the flanks, but the identity is central overloads.

blo.personaBrief: High pressing is the defining trait (Trivela, CIES ranking top, perde-pressiona, forwards pressing from the start); the low block is only one of four defensive phases.

mar.personaBrief: No source on Flamengo's own marking scheme; he used a mirrored system against Atletico, but pressing and spatial positional play suggest a space-based defence with aggressive pressing on the ball, while his Simeone/JJ influences are mixed.

pla.personaBrief: He said he would never change his team because of an opponent and arrived imposing his model, though Trivela says he backs down when it does not work and he mirrored Atletico MG and used a back five once.

res.personaBrief: Simeone and Jorge Jesus disciple: 'ganhar, ganhar e ganhar de novo'; 'defense wins titles'; five titles in 17 months, yet his team still proposes and dominates, so winning matters first with a proactive style.

sis.personaBrief: Collective model with all 11 in the same direction and tactical duties for all, rotating stars (Pedro/Arrascaeta not together), though he has quality players and an adaptive chance-creation shape needing intelligence.

jog.personaBrief: Technically strong passing volantes (Jorginho, Pulgar) and quick short passing, but huge running, intensity and pressing demands ('vamos ter que correr todo mundo').

bas.personaBrief: Former academy coach who brought staff from the base, but won titles with an expensive experienced squad (Jorginho, Pulgar, Gerson) and rotated for peak performance; titles are the goal.

lid.personaBrief: Teammate of most players, known for handling stars and a homely environment, with demanding collective rules; he says the coach should speak little and decides lineups himself.
